assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game-interface border, a single reusable nine-slice panel frame for a frozen-north fantasy roleplaying app. Create one square image, front-facing orthographic. The frame is four straight narrow rails of pale brushed steel, blue-white, rimed with hoarfrost along their edges, with a thin inner bead line and a few very small round icicle beads hanging no further than the rail itself; at each of the four corners a compact round steel boss carrying a six-point frost crystal of pale ice with one small aurora-green inlaid gem at its centre that glows softly. Material depth, fine frost crystals, cold dimensional highlights and blue-grey shadow so the rails read clearly on both a white and a near-black page: the tactile artistic UI craft of a classic fantasy strategy game, not a flat vector border. Frame aligned square to the canvas, no perspective. Each rail stays narrow, within the outer 12 percent of the image; corner bosses may fill the outer 18 percent. Keep the middle stretches of all four rails simple and continuous so they can stretch in a responsive UI. BACKGROUND: the large rectangular central opening (the central 64 percent in each dimension) and the thin space outside the frame must be filled with perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta #FF00FF, with no texture, no shadow, no gradient and no ornaments crossing it, so it can be keyed out to transparency. Frame nearly fills the canvas with a 3 percent magenta outer margin; nothing cropped. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the frame itself. Soft neutral top-left light, pale steel, ice blue-white, mid blue-grey shading, restrained aurora green. No words, no letters, no runes that look like writing, no buttons, no icons, no scenery, no watermark.
